description: Formalize-first pre-check for the binding Δ_λ ↔ q-Lommel three-term recurrence hypothesis (PR #2305 redirect; #2078 coordination). Verdict DATA-LIMITED: canonical Δ_λ is only 4 light nuclei (3 A-levels), too thin to test recurrence consistency; decisive test gated on the Subgoal-1 Borromean-tower extension. No fit (Δ_λ gate). docs/audits/2026-06-14-delta-lambda-qlommel-precheck.md.
discipline: no fit (Δ_λ gate, no 7th ansatz); derive-or-refute; data-limited honest report; nothing wired

results.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE / DATA-LIMITED (no fit attempted, per the Δ_λ gate). The canonical Δ_λ data is only the four light nuclei D/T/³He/⁴He (three A-levels, one isospin pair) — one interior level per single-isospin chain, so the three-term recurrence b_ν cannot be tested for consistency and NOTHING is falsified. Preliminary signal only: the T-chain ratios are near-constant (ρ≈2.82, 2.94; ~4% spread → roughly geometric, recurrence-compatible) while the ³He-chain ratios are not (ρ≈2.46, 3.38). DECISIVE TEST GATED on extending the same-shape Δ_λ tower to ⁶Li, ⁷Li, ⁸Be, … (the Subgoal-1 Borromean-tower extension): with ≥4 same-shape levels one can test whether b_ν is constant (C-finite) or q-Lommel-shaped (q^{-ν}-modulated) vs erratic. Until then the q-Lommel Δ_λ route is neither supported nor refuted; building a closure now would be a fit. Recommendation for #2078: extend the tower FIRST, then run this pre-check; b_ν must be substrate-derived (q-Casimir/contraction), not fitted, and pass the deuteron.
